messages:
maria: quick heads-up — last night an A/B split for search-api went to 0% because deploy-bot tripped a guard on a transient quota error. we lost the experiment signal for ~6m. need a safer fallback: min traffic floor or operator override. service=search-api, experiment=exp-juice-2026.

sanjay: ouch. can you paste the deploy-bot snippet/why it halted?

maria: here’s the event from deploy-bot logs:
```
2026-03-14T02:12:43Z deploy-bot INFO guard_action=halt_split reason=capacity_quota_exceeded target=exp-juice-2026 previous_split=0.25 new_split=0.0
```

ria: yep that matches. two ideas: (1) add a "min_floor" on the rollout config so a guard can't drive split < floor, (2) an operator_override API that requires 2 approvers + audit entry. UX should make it explicit this bypass is exceptional.

kevin: we have a crude "traffic-lock" tag but it's global. +1 for min_floor. suggestion: default min_floor = 0.1% for experiments, configurable per-deployment.

deploy-bot: @maria detected a guard-trigger on exp-juice-2026 and initiated automated hold. To proceed with an operator override, post an approval request to /api/v1/overrides. NOTE: override will be logged and requires 2 approvers.

ops-bot: created incident: https://incidents.internal/reports/INC-2026-314 (linked to deploy-bot event). tagging oncall.

maria: proposed spec:
- rollout config add: min_floor (string percent, e.g., "0.1%")
- routing runtime: evaluate min_floor before applying guard-driven zeroing; exception if guard.reason == "security" or "data-loss" (those still take precedence)
- operator_override endpoint: POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/override with body {reason, requester}, requires 2 approvals in console and emits telemetry event rollout.override.requested and rollout.override.approved
- console: show yellow banner when min_floor is applied and a red banner for security guards

sanjay: sounds good. implementation notes: runtime ordering = [safety_guards (security,data-loss), min_floor_enforcement, guard_actions]. that way security still blocks, but transient capacity errors won't zero live traffic. i'll open PR for routing-policy changes + unit tests.

ria: add an alert: metric rollout.floor_used.count if >3/day for the same service -> page ops. also emit histogram of time_floor_active_ms for observability.

maria: @aubrey can design mockups for the console banners and the two-approver UX? we need something clear for SRE and product. :pray:

aubrey: on it — will drop initial mocks by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: one more: add an operator label to audit logs (who forced it) and a TTL on override (default 30m) so we don't leave manual splits forever.

maria: agreed. next steps: sanjay PR for runtime, ria PR for telemetry/alerts, aubrey designs, kevin will update audit schema. i'll coordinate deploy-bot change to surface the override button instead of auto-halt when min_floor present.

deploy-bot: scheduled gate: requires new infra flag `allow-floor-bypass=false` to be unset before auto-halt is disabled.

maria: thanks team — syncing at standup, will track action items in the rollout epic.
